_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Devarim 14, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And since you are the devotees of God your Lord, like children — do not gash yourselves, and do not make a bare patch between your eyes for your dead.
translations.2: For you are a people consecrated to God your Lord, and He has chosen you to be His own particular nation, from all the nations that are upon the face of the earth.
translations.3: You shall not eat anything abhorrent.
translations.4: This is what you may eat of the beasts: the cattle, the sheep, and the goats,
translations.5: and the deer, and the gazelle, and the roebuck, and the ibex, and the mountain goat, and the tebel, and the giraffe.
translations.6: And every beast that is hoofed with a hoof and has its hooves split in a full split, and that brings up cud, from among the beasts — eat it.
translations.7: But these creatures, do not eat them — from among those that bring up cud and those that are hoofed with split hooves: the camel, and the hare, and the hyrax, for they bring up cud but are not hoofed with a hoof — they are forbidden to you.
translations.8: And the pig: it is hoofed with a hoof but does not chew cud — it is forbidden to you; do not eat of their flesh, and do not approach their carcasses lest they make you impure.
translations.9: And this is what you may eat from all that is in the water: everything that has fins and scales, eat it.
translations.10: And everything that has no fins and scales, do not eat it, for it is impure for you.
translations.11: And every pure bird, eat it.
translations.12: And these are the creatures you shall not eat from among them: the vulture, the eagle, and the great bird of prey,
translations.13: and the kite, and the screech-bird, and the falcon according to its kinds,
translations.14: and all the ravens according to their kinds,
translations.15: and the ostrich, and the swallow, and the gull, and the hawk according to its kinds,
translations.16: and the owl, and the sparrowhawk, and the falcon,
translations.17: and the pelican, and the carrion-vulture, and the cormorant,
translations.18: and the stork, and the parrot according to its kinds, and the hoopoe, and the bat.
translations.19: And all creeping flying creatures that are forbidden to you — do not eat them.
translations.20: And everything that is pure from among them, eat it.
translations.21: And do not eat anything from the carcasses; rather, give it to the stranger who is in your localities that he may eat it, or sell it to a foreigner — for you are a people consecrated to God your Lord. And do not cook meat in milk.
translations.22: You shall tithe a full tithe of all the yield of your sowing, that which the open country brings forth, year by year.
translations.23: And eat before God your Lord, in the place which He shall choose for His light to dwell therein, the tithes of your grain and your press-produce and your oil, and the firstlings of your cattle and your flock — so that you may learn how to serve Him all the length of time.
translations.24: And if the way be too long for you, and you are unable to carry it, and the place is far from you — the place which God your Lord shall choose for His light to dwell therein — and He has blessed you through all of this,
translations.25: then sell it for a price, and tie it up and take it in your hand, and go to the place which God your Lord shall choose.
translations.26: And spend it on whatever your soul desires — cattle and flock, and wine and strong drink, and whatever your soul wishes — and eat it there before God your Lord, and rejoice, you and your household.
translations.27: And the Levite who is in your localities — do not forsake him, since he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
translations.28: And at the end of every three years, bring out all the tithes of your yield in that year, and set it down in your localities.
translations.29: And the Levite shall come — since he has no portion nor inheritance with you — and the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow who are in your localities, and they shall eat and be satisfied, so that God your Lord may bless you in all that you do.
